pod.intro: Connect to a central in the program menu.
pod.menuHint: To open the program menu, switch the pod on and hold the button during the blue boot animation.
pod.bleUnsupported: This browser has no Bluetooth access. Use Chrome or Edge, on iPhone the app later.
pod.serialUnsupported: USB needs Chrome or Edge on a computer.

connect.bleHint: Phone or computer, central in the program menu
connect.serialHint: Computer with Chrome or Edge, any pod
connect.simulatedHint: Try the app without a pod

pod.chooseDevice: Choose the pod in the browser dialog.

errors.timeout: The pod did not answer. Is it in the program menu? Bluetooth needs firmware 2.1 or newer.
errors.openFailed: The port could not be opened. Is another program (e.g. a serial monitor) using it?
errors.notAllowed: The browser did not allow access.
errors.busy: The pod is busy (game or sync running). Return to the program menu.
errors.overflow: The pod could not keep up. Please try again.
errors.auth_required: This pod is protected with a PIN. Enter it to make changes.
errors.auth_failed: Wrong PIN. Wait 3 seconds before you try again.

pod.firmwareUnsupported: This app is made for firmware 2.x. The pod runs {{version}}; some things may not work.
pod.readOnly: Programs can only be changed on a central. This pod is shown read only.
pod.renameHint: Shown in the Bluetooth list as “ReactPod <name>”. Leave empty to use the last 4 digits of the set id.
pod.renameLater: The new name is shown after this connection ends.
pod.pinHint: This pod is protected with a PIN. The owner can change or clear it over USB.
pod.programFormatNewer: The pod knows newer block fields (format {{pod}}, app {{app}}). Update the app before you change programs.

programs.libraryHint: Read-only parts that programs include (presets) or copy (templates).
programs.connectHint: Connect a pod to see its programs
programs.reading: Reading files from the pod… {{done}} of {{total}}
programs.missingInMenu: {{path}} is in the menu but missing on the pod
programs.mineEmpty: No programs of your own yet. Create one with + or open a program and tap Edit.
programs.deleteText: “{{name}}” ({{path}}) is deleted from this device. Programs on the pod are not changed.
programs.importSetMenu: The menu ({{count}} entries) replaces the menu in this app.
programs.importSetReplaces_one: {{count}} of your programs with the same path is replaced.
programs.importSetReplaces_other: {{count}} of your programs with the same path are replaced.
programs.importSetIgnored: Not imported (library or not a program): {{files}}
programs.importSetFailed: {{file}} is not a program set (.zip with programs.json and prog/…).

editor.title: Editor
editor.noProgramHint: Create a new program, or open one in Programs and tap Edit.
editor.emptyProgram: This program has no blocks yet. Add the first one with +.
editor.presetBlock: From {{file}} (read only). To change it, use “Convert to editable copy” in the program settings.
editor.addAtEnd: added at the end, not connected
editor.templatesHelp: Copies the blocks of a library part into this program, where you can change them.
editor.nameInvalid: Letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter (max. 32).
editor.lockedBy: {{file}} continues at this block, so it cannot be renamed or deleted.
editor.variablesHelp: Whole numbers, reset at program start. Built in: {{builtins}}.
editor.menuPatternHelp: How the program shows in the pod's program menu.
editor.presetsHelp: Included library parts stay read only and are shared with other programs.

simulate.title: Simulate
simulate.noProgram: Choose a program to simulate, or create one in the editor.
simulate.hasErrors: This program has errors and cannot be simulated. Fix them in the editor first.
simulate.breakpointHint: Tap a block to set or remove a breakpoint.
simulate.podsHint: Tap a pod's button to press it. Press and hold for a long press.

status.waiting: Waiting for a press (or skip wait)

simulate.metricsHint: Times are your clicks, not measurements of a pod.

menu.title: Menu
menu.intro: Order of the programs in the pod's program menu and their LED pattern. Kept on this device and sent with push.
menu.fromPod: Starting from the menu of the connected pod.
menu.nothingToAdd: All programs are in the menu.
menu.copyNote: Changing the pattern makes a local copy of this program (same path).

settings.title: Settings
settings.consoleHint: Firmware log and events of the USB connection.
settings.deleteNotConnected: Connect a central to delete files.
settings.deleteHint: Library parts and the menu cannot be deleted. Remove a program from the menu first.
settings.deleteText: These files are deleted from the pod. This cannot be undone.

issues.notAnObject: The file must contain a JSON object
issues.invalidPath: Path {{path}} is not allowed (only /prog/…, letters, digits, _ - . /)
issues.fileTooLarge: File has {{size}} bytes, the pod accepts {{max}}
issues.includeInvalid: 'include' must be a list of paths
issues.peripheralsRange: Number of peripherals must be 0 to {{max}}
issues.variableNotInteger: Variable {{name}} must be a whole number
issues.menuInvalidColor: Menu pattern has an invalid colour
issues.menuInvalidLed: Menu pattern uses an LED outside 0 to {{max}}
issues.blockNoNameOrType: Every block needs a name and a type
issues.duplicateBlock: Block name {{name}} is used twice (also in {{other}})
issues.unsupportedType: The connected pod cannot run {{type}} blocks (firmware update needed)
issues.notValue: Must be a whole number or a variable
issues.notNamedColor: Peripherals only show the 8 named colours
issues.delayNeedsMs: Needs a duration or a minimum and maximum
issues.randomTimeoutPair: Random timeout needs both minimum and maximum
issues.portUnknownTarget: Output {{port}} leads to the missing block {{target}}
issues.noOutgoing: Nothing follows this block: the program ends here
issues.unknownField: Unknown setting {{field}} is ignored by the pod
issues.indexNotProgram: {{path}} is a library part, not a program
issues.fieldNeedsFormat: The connected pod ignores {{field}} (needs program format {{format}}, firmware update needed)
issues.timerNeverStopped: Stopwatch {{name}} is started but never stopped
issues.timerNeverStarted: Stopwatch {{name}} is stopped but never started
issues.repeatNoLoop: No step of the round leads back to this repeat

portRoles.ifRedHit: If a red pod is hit

led.name: LED
led.help: Sets the central's LEDs to a colour, all or selected ones. Continues at once.

delay.name: Wait
delay.help: Waits a fixed or random time.

button.name: Button
button.help: Waits for a press of the central's button. Only presses that start after the block began count.

if.name: If
if.help: Compares two values and continues at true or false.

setVariable.name: Set variable
setVariable.help: Sets, adds, subtracts or draws a random value.

remotePress.name: Light pod
remotePress.help: Lights one peripheral and waits for its press. The reaction time is measured on the pod.

remoteMultiPress.name: Light several pods
remoteMultiPress.help: Lights several pods at once, some may be red (do not press).

remoteResetAll.name: Pods off
remoteResetAll.help: Switches the peripherals (and the central) off.

summary.name: Summary
summary.help: Average, best and worst of a measurement, printed on the serial console.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.help: Runs the round (body) a number of times, then continues at done. The last step of the round leads back here.

leds.label: LEDs
leds.help: Tap LEDs to switch them on or off.

ms.label: Time (ms)
ms.help: Fixed wait. Or set min and max for a random wait.

shortMs.label: Short press up to (ms)
shortMs.help: Shorter presses leave at “short”, longer ones at “long”.

timeoutMs.label: Time-out (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Without a press in this time the block leaves at “time-out”.

record.label: Measure as
record.help: Name of the measurement, e.g. reaction. Used by the summary.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: hit: press when lit. avoid: do not press.

pods.label: Number of pods
pods.help: Empty: all pods of the program.

count.label: Rounds
count.help: How many times the round runs.

timerStart.label: Start stopwatch
timerStart.help: Starts this stopwatch when the step begins.

timerStop.label: Stop stopwatch
timerStop.help: When the step ends, records the time since the start under this name.

sync.title: Sync
sync.clean: The pod has everything from this app.
sync.conflictHint: Changed here and on the pod. Choose which one to keep.
sync.restoreText: The shipped programs, the library and the default menu are written to the pod. Your programs on the pod stay, but are no longer in the menu. The menu in this app then follows the pod again.
sync.skipped_one: {{count}} file is not pushed (conflict or changed on the pod).
sync.skipped_other: {{count}} files are not pushed (conflict or changed on the pod).
sync.stopped: Nothing was changed: the pod's check found errors.
sync.spreadHint: Start any program once with all pods switched on, so the whole set gets the new programs.
sync.partial_one: {{count}} file was uploaded before. Push again to finish.
sync.partial_other: {{count}} files were uploaded before. Push again to finish.

results.deleteAthleteText_one: {{name}} and {{count}} training session are deleted from this phone.
results.deleteAthleteText_other: {{name}} and {{count}} training sessions are deleted from this phone.
results.deleteAthleteRemote: Results already uploaded stay on the platform. Delete them there.
results.athleteNameHint: Stored on this phone only, until you link the athlete to a platform profile.
results.athleteMissing: This athlete does not exist (any more).
results.sessionMissing: This training session does not exist (any more).
results.empty: No athletes yet. Add one, then choose them on the Pod tab before a training.
results.unassignedHint: Results recorded while no athlete was chosen. Open a session to assign it.
results.notDurable: This browser does not allow storage. Results are kept until the app is closed, and the pods keep their reports.
results.deleteSessionText_one: The session with {{count}} report is deleted from this phone.
results.deleteSessionText_other: The session with {{count}} reports is deleted from this phone.
results.deleteSessionRemote: It stays on the platform. Delete it there.

training.title: Training
training.noReports: This pod sends no results yet: live results need a firmware with reports. You can still choose the athlete for later.
training.noRemote: This pod cannot be controlled from the app: the program goes on with the button or after the timeout.

sent.repeat: The pod repeats; the last report is discarded.

errors.busy: The athlete can only change in the program menu or while the pod waits for the app.
errors.not_ready: The pod is not waiting for the app right now.

platform.title: Platform (preview)
platform.intro: Optional: upload results to athlete profiles on the ReactPod community platform. The app works without it; results wait on this phone until you are online.
platform.codeSent: If the address is known, a mail with a 6-digit code and a link is on its way. The code works for 15 minutes.
platform.lastFailed_one: {{count}} session could not be uploaded ({{code}}). It is tried again later.
platform.lastFailed_other: {{count}} sessions could not be uploaded ({{code}}). They are tried again later.
platform.linked: Linked to a profile in {{org}}. New results are uploaded there.
platform.notLinked: Not linked: results stay on this phone.
platform.signInFirst: Sign in and choose a club first.
platform.consent: The athlete (for minors: the parents) agreed that their results are stored on the platform.
platform.noServer: Enter the server in the platform settings first, then open the link again.
